title: Through holes drilled to the break-through only: the drill point is not added, so a 118 deg drill leaves a ~0.8 mm lip; break_through is not listed by list_operation_types

labels.name: in-review
labels.description: Fix pushed on a branch with an open PR; merges at the next cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3

body:
## What happens

A through hole drilled with a twist drill only gets the fixed break-through below the part bottom (1.0 mm by default, #1557). The drill's point length is not added, so full diameter never reaches the bottom: with a 6 mm 118 deg drill the point is 3 / tan(59 deg) = 1.80 mm long, the tip stops at z -1 and full diameter ends at z +0.8. Each "through" hole leaves a ~0.8 mm cone/lip at the exit. Generate and verify say ok.

Also: the `break_through` parameter from #1557 is not listed by `list_operation_types` for Drill (its default is `null`, so the field is skipped), so an MCP agent cannot find it; the QA agent reported "no break-through option".

## Expected

For a through hole, the depth puts the full diameter at least the break-through below the bottom: bottom - break_through - point length (from the tool's tip angle and diameter), or a stated choice between "tip" and "full diameter"; and `list_operation_types` lists `break_through`.

## Repro (MCP, upstream main abe24ff09)

**Part (p01-flange):** 6061 plate 100 x 60 x 10 mm centred on the origin (z 0..10), a 60 x 30 x 5 mm island on top (z 10..15, R5 corners) with a 1 x 45 deg chamfer on its top edges, 4 x dia 6 through holes at (+-42, +-22), a 10 mm wide x 3 mm deep slot across the +X end (x 35..45, floor z 7). Stock: box fitted to the model with +2 mm on top (100 x 60 x 17, z 0..17). WCS G54 at the stock's min-X min-Y top corner, world (-50, -30, 17). Machine Tormach 770MX, post Tormach PathPilot.

`add_tool {catalog: "DR-0600"}` (D6, tip_angle 118); `add_operation {kind: "Drill", tool: "DR-0600", source: "flange", params: {cycle: "peck", peck: 2}}`; `detect_holes`; `generate`; `post`.

Posted (WCS Z0 = world 17): `G73 X8 Y8 Z-18 R-2 Q2 F300` - Z-18 = world -1, one break-through below the bottom, with no point length.

P3: wrong output a user hits (holes not through at size, burr ring at the exit, verify silent), with a workaround (state a larger break_through by hand). Not a gouge.

Found by the QA swarm (SolidCraft v0.44.1 + CamCraft v0.23.0, part p01-flange). Re-checked on upstream main abe24ff09.

**Done means:** a through hole's posted depth takes the drill point into account (or offers that choice), the sim shows a clean exit, `list_operation_types` lists `break_through`, and a test pins Z for a 6 mm 118 deg drill on a 10 mm plate.
